message: Hi, we have had the sofa three weeks now and honestly it's too big for the room. It's still in the plastic, we never sat on it. Can we send it back?
The table arrived yesterday with a deep gouge across the top and one leg split at the joint. Photos attached. I don't want a replacement, just my money back please.
The moss velvet looks much darker in person than on the website. I'd like to return the chair. It's in perfect condition.
The bed frame came three weeks late and when we unboxed it the headboard was cracked down the middle. We need a refund.
Changed my mind on the lamp, it's unused and boxed. How do I return it?
Two of the table's legs arrived with the veneer peeling off and a big scratch on the top. Reporting it straight away. Please refund.
The bookshelf has started to lean after two months. I want a refund, this shouldn't happen to solid walnut.
The rug was nearly three weeks late, and now that it's down it's the wrong shade for our floor. It's barely been walked on but we did take it out of the wrapping. Can I return it?
